_comment: Hand-maintained Slayer task preparation data. Task keys are Slayer task names in lower case, as the RuneLite Slayer plugin reports them. 'required' lists worn items, by slot, that the task needs; any one name per slot satisfies it. 'inventory' lists items to carry; each entry is satisfied by any one of its names (matched as a prefix, so 'Fungicide spray' matches 'Fungicide spray 10'). 'dragonfire' is 'dragon' or 'wyvern'. 'locations' are used when the Slayer plugin does not report a task location. Teleport 'items' are name prefixes used to tick off teleports you own; leave it out for spells or fairy rings. 'cannon': true marks tasks commonly done with a dwarf cannon (the spot must allow one). 'stacks': true marks tasks where monsters bunch up, so bursting or barraging works well. Inventory entries with 'perKill': true are used up on every kill (one per kill, so the plan suggests as many as there are kills left); 'stackable': true means they fit in one slot. 'comboEat': true marks tasks whose monsters hit hard enough that karambwans for combo eating are worth bringing. 'masters' lists teleports back to each Slayer master, best first, for the Slayer master setting. 'safespots' are short text descriptions, summarised from the OSRS Wiki, with an optional 'location' (shown for that location only when the Slayer plugin reports one). Text only: never add bosses, Slayer bosses or demi-bosses, and never draw tiles. 'locationNeeds' are what a location itself needs, whatever the task: worn items ('required'), carried items ('inventory') and 'tips'. They apply when the Slayer plugin reports that location, or the task lists only that one; otherwise their 'summary' becomes a tip. Task 'tips' are shown as they are. Inventory entries may set 'killsEach' (one item covers this many kills), 'maxCount', 'optional' (not flagged when missing) and 'exact' (match names exactly).

safespots.text: Use the walls, brick piles or suits of armour to block them. Ranged or Magic only: you need at least 6 tiles between you.
Several spots, but most only work once they stop being aggressive.
Deviant spectres: stand south of the arch below the steel dragons and attack across the water.
Can't really be safespotted: they teleport themselves or you around when hit.
Large south-west room: stand on the south side of the south-easternmost skeleton.
Behind the south-west coffin, between the bone spawns (around level 30 Wilderness).
Along the east wall and in the south-east corner of the room.
Two squares south of the torch on the south side of the stairs.
Twisted banshees here can be safespotted and have better drops.
From the southern entrance using the south-east wall, or behind the rocks on either side. You still need a mirror shield: their gaze is ranged.
Next to the agility pipe; you can cannon 2 or 3 of the 4 demons from there.
Bottom floor: by the stalagmites in the far north, or in the centre by the Voice of Yama.
The two near the Obelisk of Fire: stand behind the ladder. Upper level (task only): spots in the middle; the left one is safer.
Centre room: the north-east corner behind the chair, or by the armour stands and wardrobes. Basement: the north-west corner between the chest, chair, broken table and shelves.
East room: north of some rocks and east of a pillar. The north-east section also works with a cannon, but is often busy.
Behind the brick piles north-east of the entrance rope. Wear a Saradomin and a Zamorak item.
From the south-west path to the hill giants.
Behind the columns and large rocks; a halberd works too.
The fenced-off dragon can be safespotted.
Spots for one or two dragons at a time (needs part of Watchtower).
Inside the stalagmite nook with two adamantite rocks on the east side, or in the northern passage.
Use the rocks around the walls of the room.
Next to the entrance behind the Fire of Eternal Light, or just past it between the stalagmites and the lake.
Behind the large rock formation to the north.
Lure them round a corner so they get stuck, or stand behind a warped jelly (not aggressive).
Range them across the water.
South-west corner: trap them on the edges of the crates.
At the entrance to the fire giant area, or next to the pillar of fire in the middle.
Next to the single door in the western room (once they stop being aggressive).
Groups of three giants, each with a safespot nearby.
Top floor: by the doorway in the south-west. Basement: the north-east corner behind the bucket.
Several spots to range them from (Wilderness).
Near fairy ring DKP: between the two trees to the south behind the small jungle plant, or on the beach by the fairy ring.
On the rocks and columns in the lower section.
In the hallway; stand on its east side or one can reach you.
At the entrance to their section, against the north wall.
Fire over the rocks in the west of the room, or the south near the turoth.
From the east or west shore.
Use the clouds or holes so they can't get into melee range. They still attack with magic from range.
The north-west corner of the lower level.
The northern wall of the southernmost kurask section.

tips: Magic Dart with a Slayer's staff also works on them, but isn't counted in the DPS, so Magic shows nothing.

By the fairy ring, the STASH unit to the west, or along the shore.

safespots.text: Terrorbirds: at the start of the dungeon, with a weapon that reaches 9 tiles or more (a crossbow on longrange). They never stop being aggressive, so most other spots don't work.
Tortoises: behind the pillars further in.

tips: Earmuffs or a Slayer helmet halve the terrorbirds' damage.
